transcript: You don't have to pay for Runway or Kling AI videos anymore. LTX 2.5 just dropped, and it's a completely open video model. All of the outputs are just way cleaner. You get sharper faces, more readable text, way fewer smears in any sort of motion. And if you guys want to try it for yourselves, just comment "LTX" down below, and I'll send you the link directly.
